overview: 2026年，公司获得价值RM180,000,000的医院主楼工程合约，并完成收购SJEE Engineering 51%股权，将业务扩展至工程领域；同时终止与MCC Overseas及Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics的谅解备忘录，并作为收购方对Nova Pharma Solutions发起无条件强制全面收购。
overview_en: In 2026, the Company secured a RM180,000,000 contract for main building works of a hospital and completed the acquisition of 51% equity interest in SJEE Engineering, expanding into engineering; it also terminated the MOU with MCC Overseas and Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics, and launched an unconditional mandatory general offer for Nova Pharma Solutions as the offeror.

segments.name: 建筑
segments.note: 获得Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh的医院主楼工程合约，合约总额RM180,000,000。
segments.note_en: Secured a contract for main building works of Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh with a total contract sum of RM180,000,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Southern Score Sdn Bhd接受Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh的授标函，承接位于Melaka的医院主楼工程，合约总额RM180,000,000（不含销售与服务税）。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Southern Score Sdn Bhd accepted a letter of award from Radium Hospital Ayer Keroh to undertake main building works for a hospital in Melaka, with a total contract sum of RM180,000,000 (excluding sales and service tax).

segments.name: 工程
segments.note: 通过收购SJEE Engineering 51%股权，将业务扩展至工程领域。
segments.note_en: Expanded into engineering through the acquisition of 51% equity interest in SJEE Engineering.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订第二份补充协议，以现金RM22,950,000收购SJEE Engineering Sdn Bhd 51%股权。
actions.text_en: Entered into a second supplemental agreement to acquire 51% equity interest in SJEE Engineering Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM22,950,000.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 终止与MCC Overseas及Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics的谅解备忘录，并对Nova Pharma Solutions发起无条件强制全面收购。
segments.note_en: Terminated the MOU with MCC Overseas and Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics, and launched an unconditional mandatory general offer for Nova Pharma Solutions.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 终止与MCC Overseas (M) Sdn Bhd及Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co. Ltd.的谅解备忘录，因合作缺乏实质进展。
actions.text_en: Terminated the Memorandum of Understanding with MCC Overseas (M) Sdn Bhd and Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co. Ltd. due to lack of material progress in the intended collaboration.

actions.title: OFFER DOCUMENT IN RELATION TO THE UNCONDITIONAL MANDATORY TAKE-OVER OFFER BY SOUTHERN SCORE BUILDERS BERHAD ("OFFEROR") THROUGH KENANGA INVE
actions.text: 作为收购方，以每股RM0.37现金对Nova Pharma Solutions Berhad发起无条件强制全面收购。
actions.text_en: As the offeror, launched an unconditional mandatory general offer for Nova Pharma Solutions Berhad at RM0.37 cash per offer share.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过收购SJEE Engineering 51%股权，将业务扩展至工程领域。
model_changes.text_en: Expanded into engineering through the acquisition of 51% equity interest in SJEE Engineering.
